rules.basis: The 15K sheet states peak surge power for 10 s and 30 min, the time in the name.
The Limitless 15K sheet states the idle consumption with no load, without a unit on the line, so it is a gap that names the figure.
The sheets state the AC voltages as '120/240, 120/208 V', which the parser refuses as a list, so the figure is named and the gap says so.
The 5K, 8K, 12K and 15K sheets state the nominal DC voltage, 48 V, under the battery.

The sheets state one battery current for charge and discharge, 120 A for the 5K, 185 A for the 12K, 275 A for the 15K; a figure per terminal is not the unit's total, and the manuals' 'Max A Charge' is a settings screen's field, printed as 185 A on the 5K whose sheet says 120 A, so neither is read.

The sheets state the PV input limit as 500 V under most of these names, '1,000 VOC' on the 60K, and 550 V as 'Max VOC of MPPTs' in the 30K's manual, which disagrees with the 500 V its sheet prints under 'PV input voltage maximum' and is published as a conflict; 'Max recommended input voltage per MPPT' is a recommendation below the limit and is not read.
The 15K sheet states 'Max. Input Short Circuit Current', 44 A, and the 30K's manual 'ISC of MPPTs', 55 A: the short-circuit limit of the PV input.

names: Max. Usable Combined MPPT PV Power
Max PV power delivered to Battery & AC outputs
rules.basis: The sheets state the most PV the unit uses as '13 kW (± 5%)', which the parser refuses for its tolerance, or in watts, the 12K-P's as 'Max PV power delivered to Battery & AC outputs', 12,000 W; 'Max. STC Rated PV Power', 'Max allowed PV DC Capacity' and the shared file's 'Max. Allowed PV Power', set aside under except, are array sizes above what the unit uses, 13,000 W beside that 12,000 W, and are not read.
The sheets state the PV power per MPPT, so the figure is per input.
